st_departs.name: Halte des Départs
st_departs.alt: A tiny country railway halt in a flowery garden, with an old red-brown tram carriage on a short track, a green ticket booth, a big tree and a stone bridge over the canal, painted in ink and gouache: Monsieur Verbe leads toy soldiers marching out of the ticket booth in a gold beret; waves to the porter and sets off with his suitcase in a gold beret; brings two shy hedgehogs together under a toadstool; runs back into the carriage with a tray of cream cakes; climbs back onto his pony; and waves goodbye from the carriage step with his party balloons in a gold beret. The lane at the top left leads back to the crossroads. The steps down to the canal, the path behind the tree, the stairs up the hill and the iron gateway lead on.

doors.hint: Down the stone steps to the canal quay

doors.label: Piste des Galopins

doors.hint: Up the stone stairs on the hill

doors.label: Marché des Pressés
doors.hint: Through the iron gateway to the market

retours.name: Quai des Retours
retours.alt: A quiet green canal quay below the railway halt, with a towpath, a moored barge, a willow, an old clock post and a little boathouse: Monsieur Verbe carries a freshly varnished table off the barge in a gold beret; holds out his palm, refusing to climb the clock post; chases a rat that escaped from its trap; jumps back from a cucumber on the path; holds up his hand while his little dog stays on its rug; and climbs a ladder to take his red ball back from a crow on the boathouse roof. The stone stairs on the left lead back up to the halt; the steps up the hill lead on.

doors.label: Halte des Départs
doors.hint: Climb the stairs back up to the halt

doors.label: Chemin des Grimpeurs
doors.hint: Up the steps on the hill

grimpeurs.name: Chemin des Grimpeurs
grimpeurs.alt: A grassy hillside path above the railway halt, with a stone cottage, a big tree with a kite caught in it, a little clock tower and a view over the canal valley: Monsieur Verbe tucks the key under the doormat and walks off; picks up his suitcase to leave again as his parrot squawks, in a gold beret; bows to his own reflection in a hand mirror beside a horse; climbs a mountain of mashed potato with gravy in a green beret; climbs the tree for the kite while Grandpa waits with a cake; and scales the clock tower on a tiny ladder. The stone steps on the left lead back down; the path under the green market awnings leads on.

doors.label: Halte des Départs
doors.hint: Back down the stone steps to the halt

doors.label: Marché des Pressés
doors.hint: On under the green market awnings

presses.name: Marché des Pressés
presses.alt: A busy little country market lane beside the railway halt, under green canvas awnings, with a bakery stall, a hat stall and villagers: Monsieur Verbe zooms past a cabbage on a giant racing snail; hurries with a hatbox, glancing in his hand mirror; rushes his newspaper to the printing press, mirror in hand; climbs a step ladder to reach the cookie jar; dozes wearily in a rocking chair with his mirror drooping; and is lifted high on two villagers' shoulders with his hamster and his mirror. The old station clock on the left leads back to the halt; the stone arch leads on.

doors.label: Halte des Départs
doors.hint: Back past the station clock to the halt

doors.label: Piste des Galopins
doors.hint: Through the stone arch to the farm track

galopins.name: Piste des Galopins
galopins.alt: A muddy farm track behind the railway halt, with a wooden fence, a meadow, the old tram in the distance and an open manhole: Monsieur Verbe leaps over the fence beside a little fawn in a green beret; follows muddy paw prints with a magnifying glass; gallops on his pony with a baguette; heaves a huge trunk onto a cart; pops out of the manhole in a hard hat, nose to nose with a mole; and sets off round the world with a backpack, a globe and a tortoise in a gold beret. The stone archway on the left leads back to the halt.

doors.label: Halte des Départs
doors.hint: Back through the stone archway to the halt
